verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It derives the needed Bezout identity from well-ordering, proves the two coprimality/divisibility consequences used later, constructs a simultaneous solution by the standard CRT sum, verifies each congruence, and proves uniqueness modulo the product by induction. The statement is self-contained, all relevant hypotheses are used, no prohibited justification occurs, and there are no external or fact-graph references requiring validation.
